text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and D after sharp drops, then buying B again, showed me to avoid reacting to losses without reassessing why I own a stock.","Several periods with no trades coincided with the account recovering, so I don’t need to trade just because I check prices often.","A few strong months did not erase earlier declines; I’ll track progress across many months and keep each decision consistent with my ten-year goal."]}
